parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, c.resume_text, c.embedding, a.id as application_id, a.job_id
FROM candidates c
JOIN applications a ON a.candidate_id = c.id
WHERE a.job_id = $1 AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND c.resume_text IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $2::vector
LIMIT 10;

parameters.content:
🟢 Start
Called with a job_id — either automatically after a job is published, or when a recruiter clicks 'Evaluate with AI'.

🗄️ Load the job & turn it into a vector
Fetches the job details, then AI converts them into a search vector.

🔎 Find close matches
Compares the job's vector to every candidate's resume vector and pulls the closest 20.

🔁 Go one by one
Processes the 20 candidates one at a time through the AI so nothing gets skipped.

🧠 AI scores each candidate
Rates skills, experience and projects out of 100 for each candidate against the job.

⚖️ Combine the scores
Blends the three scores into one final number using set weights.

🏆 Pick the best 5
Sorts everyone by their final score, keeps the top 5, and asks AI to explain why each one ranks where they do.

🗄️ Save the results
Writes each top candidate's score and AI explanation back onto their application.

📤 Send result back
Returns the top 5 ranked candidates to the dashboard.

Also extract any job title, candidate name, or IDs mentioned. Return ONLY JSON: { intent, job_title, candidate_name, candidate_id, job_id }.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.body.message } ] }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT c.name, i.feedback, i.rating, i.recommendation
FROM interviews i
JOIN applications a ON a.id = i.application_id
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
WHERE c.name ILIKE $1
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 3;

parameters.content:
🟢 Start
Every message typed into the AI Chatbot arrives here.

🧠 AI figures out what's being asked
Works out if the recruiter wants to search candidates, understand a score, get interview questions, or something else.

🔀 Send to the right branch
Only one of the branches below runs, based on what the AI decided above.

🔍 Search Candidates
Finds the candidates that best match what was asked, using the search vectors.

📊 Explain a Score
Looks up the candidate's saved AI score and explanation.

📝 Interview Questions
Pulls the candidate's resume and the job details so AI can write tailored questions.

💬 Summarize Feedback
Grabs the candidate's recent interview feedback.

🌐 General Question
No specific data needed — AI answers from general recruiting knowledge.

🧠 AI writes the final answer
Uses whatever information was gathered above to write a reply that sticks to real data.

🗄️ Save & reply
Logs the question and answer, then sends the answer back to the chat window.

parameters.query:
SELECT i.*, a.id as application_id, a.job_id, a.candidate_id, a.score,
       c.name as candidate_name, c.email as candidate_email, j.title as job_title
FROM interviews i
JOIN applications a ON a.id = i.application_id
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
WHERE i.id = $1;

parameters.content:
🟢 Start
Called once an interview is marked Completed with feedback.

🗄️ Gather everything
Pulls the interview, application, candidate and job details in one go.

🧠 AI reads the feedback
Checks if the interviewer's written feedback is positive or negative, and how detailed it is.

⚖️ Work out a final score
Combines the application score, interview rating, and feedback quality into one number.

🧠 AI suggests a decision
Based on the final score, suggests hire, review, or reject — with reasons.

🔀 Send to the right branch
Sends the candidate down the hire / review / reject path.

🔐 Wait for a human
For borderline cases, pauses here and waits for a recruiter to approve or reject — AI never decides alone.

✅ Hire
Marks the candidate as hired, AI writes an offer letter, and it's emailed automatically.

❌ Reject
Marks the candidate as rejected, AI writes a polite rejection email, and it's emailed automatically.

🗄️ Record what happened
Saves a notification and an audit log entry so there's a full record of the decision.
